text: [excited] A robot came to clean a reporter's apartment... and had to be carried up the stairs.
[amused] Thirty dollars an hour. Claw hands. Grippy socks.
[whispers] The twist? A human steers it, remotely, from headquarters.
[curious] On the front steps, it climbed like it was drunk.
[surprised] Then it froze. The pilot's equipment had overheated.
[deadpan] Visit two: the toilet. The brush head fell off three times.
[deadpan] Three times, it poked it back on.
[playfully] Would you pay a robot to clean your toilet? Send this to someone who hates chores.
